The bakery was supposed to be closed.

Mara knew this because she had personally locked the door, turned off the ovens, and threatened the ancient cash register with replacement if it made one more mysterious beeping noise.

Then something crashed in the kitchen.

[startled] “WHO’S THERE?”

Silence.

[whispering] “I have a rolling pin, and I’m emotionally prepared to use it.”

A head slowly appeared from behind the counter. It belonged to Theo, her next-door neighbor, holding a cupcake.

[surprised] “Mara?”

[angry] “THEO?!”

He froze.

[annoyed] “Why are you in my bakery at midnight?”

[silly] “Would you believe I’m a highly trained pastry inspector?”

[bitter] “You’re holding the evidence.”

Theo looked at the cupcake in his hand.

[disgusted] “Wait. Is this *raisins*?”

[hysterical] “HAHA! YOU STOLE THE RAISIN ONE!”

[hostile] “You did that deliberately.”

[joyful] “Absolutely.”

Theo took a cautious bite.

His expression changed.

[flabbergasted] “Oh my God.”

[delighted] “Good?”

[ecstatic] “THIS IS THE BEST CUPCAKE I’VE EVER HAD!”

[laughing] “It’s still a raisin cupcake, Theo.”

[thrilled] “I DON’T CARE! I’VE BEEN CONVERTED!”

Mara leaned against the counter, watching him demolish it. For a moment, neither of them spoke.

Then Theo noticed the flour on her cheek.

[longing] “You know… I’ve wanted an excuse to come in here after closing for months.”

Mara's smile faded into something softer.

[lust] “You never needed an excuse.”

Theo nearly dropped the cupcake wrapper.

[startled] “Oh.”

[whispering] “Oh.”

Mara stepped closer.

[joyful] “You’re turning red.”

[annoyed] “I am not.”

[silly] “You look like a tomato that just received a marriage proposal.”

[laughing] “Stop.”

[delighted] “Make me.”

Theo stared at her.

[surprised] “Was that flirting?”

[bitter] “No, Theo. I threaten all my burglars romantically.”

[flabbergasted] “Wait—you’ve been flirting with me this entire time?”

Mara stared at him for three long seconds.

[angry] “YES!”

Theo blinked.

Then—

[ecstatic] “YES!”

[hysterical] “WHY ARE YOU YELLING?!”

[thrilled] “I DON’T KNOW!”

They both dissolved into laughter.

Eventually, Mara pulled one final cupcake from beneath the counter.

Theo gasped.

[longing] “Is that chocolate?”

[hostile] “Don’t touch it.”

[whispering] “Mara…”

[disgusted] “You already ate my last raisin cupcake.”

[silly] “But sharing is caring.”

She narrowed her eyes.

Then broke the cupcake in half.

[joyful] “Fine.”

Theo accepted his half like a sacred artifact.

[delighted] “Best burglary ever.”

Mara bumped her shoulder against his.

[whispering] “Come back tomorrow.”

Theo smiled.

[thrilled] “When you’re open?”

Mara smiled back.

[lust] “After closing.”

Theo dropped his cupcake.
